title: The pup alone on the flats
logline: The pup on the flats with the leash trailing from his collar and nobody at the end of it. The Absent months' one page with a living thing in it. Who let him out: the page's answer is the bowl, full, on an earlier page.

panels.composition: A small three-legged dog on wide mudflats with a leash trailing behind it from its collar and no one holding it, the chimney far off.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small three-legged dog on wide tidal mudflats with a leash trailing from its collar and no one holding it, a distant chimney across the bay, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Nobody at the end of the leash.
